items.text: Added cooldown to livestock flee trigger, improved herd regrouping radius, staggered bull flee rules, and enabled bull kick and charge to protect the herd; fixes cows not fleeing and prevents instant deceleration after attacks.
Fixed excessive acceleration on cows and sheep and added automated tests for bull and cow fleeing behavior.
Fixed null‑reference crash when a livestock animal dies.
Introduced overgrazing: livestock can deplete grass, halting grazing until moved to fresh grass or a trough; affected animals display a label.
Adjusted herd regrouping logic to reduce erratic movement after attacks.
Improved client‑side prediction for grenades and thrown weapons by using simulated positions and Rigidbody data, and added support for flares and molotov effects.
Fixed missing arrowheads when equipping a pre‑loaded crossbow.
Flare now ignites, can be thrown in third‑person view with correct spawn offset, and idle behavior is fixed.
Fixed triangle hatch deployment being blocked by nearby deployables.
Resolved collider mismatches on monument and barrel blockers, ensuring consistent blocking and preventing players from passing through destroyed blockers.
Disabled shield compatibility with flashlights to avoid unintended interactions.
Fixed "guid is empty" server error on first item drop and corrected efficiency upgrade size scaling.
Added analogue accelerate and brake support mapped to triggers, introduced horn and seat‑swap buttons, and disabled steering while in UI.
Critters now follow realistic sleep cycles: rabbits are crepuscular, squirrels are diurnal, and bullfrogs stay active all day.
Removed squirrel and rabbit interest mechanics, altering their behavior around players and objects.
Paintball guns now correctly display their custom colors in both first‑person and third‑person views.
Livestock animals now have proper hurt and death animations, making combat interactions clearer.
Toast notifications now correctly parse and display tokenized phrases, fixing broken messages.
Additional phrase handling fix restores proper display of certain toast messages.
Contact list notes are now saved and shown correctly, fixing missing or incorrect notes.

2026-09-02.summary:
### Livestock & Herd Management
- Added cooldown to livestock flee trigger, improved herd regrouping radius, staggered bull flee rules, and enabled bull kick and charge to protect the herd; fixes cows not fleeing and prevents instant deceleration after attacks.
- Fixed excessive acceleration on cows and sheep and added automated tests for bull and cow fleeing behavior.
- Fixed null‑reference crash when a livestock animal dies.
- Introduced overgrazing: livestock can deplete grass, halting grazing until moved to fresh grass or a trough; affected animals display a label.
- Adjusted herd regrouping logic to reduce erratic movement after attacks.

### Weapons & Projectile Prediction
- Improved client‑side prediction for grenades and thrown weapons by using simulated positions and Rigidbody data, and added support for flares and molotov effects.
- Fixed missing arrowheads when equipping a pre‑loaded crossbow.
- Flare now ignites, can be thrown in third‑person view with correct spawn offset, and idle behavior is fixed.

### Building & World Interactions
- Fixed triangle hatch deployment being blocked by nearby deployables.
- Resolved collider mismatches on monument and barrel blockers, ensuring consistent blocking and preventing players from passing through destroyed blockers.
- Disabled shield compatibility with flashlights to avoid unintended interactions.

### Server & Item Stability
- Fixed "guid is empty" server error on first item drop and corrected efficiency upgrade size scaling.

### Vehicle Controls
- Added analogue accelerate and brake support mapped to triggers, introduced horn and seat‑swap buttons, and disabled steering while in UI.

### NPC & AI
- Critters now follow realistic sleep cycles: rabbits are crepuscular, squirrels are diurnal, and bullfrogs stay active all day.
- Removed squirrel and rabbit interest mechanics, altering their behavior around players and objects.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Paintball guns now correctly display their custom colors in both first‑person and third‑person views.
- Livestock animals now have proper hurt and death animations, making combat interactions clearer.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Toast notifications now correctly parse and display tokenized phrases, fixing broken messages.
- Additional phrase handling fix restores proper display of certain toast messages.
- Contact list notes are now saved and shown correctly, fixing missing or incorrect notes.

items.text: Fixed egg vision not appearing and other candy/egg vision inconsistencies when changing skins on the crafting/inventory screens.
Prevented multiple fuse‑insert clan events from firing when a player inserts several fuses in one container session.
Removed a per‑zoom allocation and hardened GetScopeMod to stop rare null‑reference crashes when using a scope.
Added a toast message informing players that modular cars now include a handbrake; the toast can appear up to five times per driver seat mount.
First pass implementation of rabbit interest behavior (WIP).
First pass implementation of squirrel interest mechanic (WIP).
Fixed RussianRouletteStorage CanAcceptItem logic, updated prefab and localization for the Russian roulette feature.
Increased sprinkler radiation output by an additional 1.5×.
Sprinklers using radwater now emit double radiation output.
Attack helicopter frame colliders restored, preventing unintended damage to players.
Monument blockers added to red key card doors in Underwater Labs, restricting access to those areas.
Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame, preventing unintended damage to players.
Implemented initial control-set support for cars, boats, helicopters, submarines, horses, and trains, enabling distinct input mappings.
Added on-screen toast notifying players that modular cars now have a functional handbrake (max 5 per session).
Increased radiation output of sprinkler systems when using radwater: doubled base output plus a 1.5× multiplier.
Corrected fuse insertion events for clans so multiple fuses inserted during the same container opening no longer trigger duplicate events.
Fixed a race condition that could corrupt items in DisplayBoxStorage, ensuring saved items remain consistent.
Instantiated PaintballColorLookup early to prevent save-time crashes from multithreaded access.
Hardened scope code to stop rare null-reference errors when using a scope.
Added monument blockers to red key-card doors in Underwater Labs, altering access routes.
Fixed Russian Roulette storage logic (CanAcceptItem), updated prefab and localization, and rebuilt the manifest.
Introduced a placeholder milk item.
Added a first-pass squirrel interest mechanic, affecting how squirrels react to player actions.

2026-09-01.summary:
### Vehicles & Controls
- Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame, preventing unintended damage to players.
- Implemented initial control-set support for cars, boats, helicopters, submarines, horses, and trains, enabling distinct input mappings.
- Added on-screen toast notifying players that modular cars now have a functional handbrake (max 5 per session).

### Environmental Hazards
- Increased radiation output of sprinkler systems when using radwater: doubled base output plus a 1.5× multiplier.

### Clan & Event Mechanics
- Corrected fuse insertion events for clans so multiple fuses inserted during the same container opening no longer trigger duplicate events.

### Gameplay Stability & World Changes
- Fixed a race condition that could corrupt items in DisplayBoxStorage, ensuring saved items remain consistent.
- Instantiated PaintballColorLookup early to prevent save-time crashes from multithreaded access.
- Hardened scope code to stop rare null-reference errors when using a scope.
- Added monument blockers to red key-card doors in Underwater Labs, altering access routes.

### Content Additions & AI
- Fixed Russian Roulette storage logic (CanAcceptItem), updated prefab and localization, and rebuilt the manifest.
- Introduced a placeholder milk item.
- Added a first-pass squirrel interest mechanic, affecting how squirrels react to player actions.
